title: 不同意团队方案时，怎样把分歧推进成决定
topic: 读 Uber 文化准则，练习邀请不同意见、基于理由讨论并推动方案落地。

source.title: Uber’s Cultural Norms
source.section: How we work: celebrate differences, act like owners, value ideas over hierarchy
paragraphs: We encourage different opinions and approaches to be heard, and then we come together and build.

We seek out problems and we solve them. We help each other and those who matter to us. We have a bias for action and accountability. We finish what we start and we build Uber to last. And when we make mistakes, we’ll own up to them.

We believe that the best ideas can come from anywhere, both inside and outside our company. Our job is to seek out those ideas, to shape and improve them through candid debate, and to take them from concept to action.
translations: 我们鼓励大家表达不同意见和做法，然后一起合作、推进建设。
我们主动发现并解决问题，互相帮助。我们强调行动和责任，完成开始的工作；犯错时也会承认。
我们相信好点子可能来自公司内外任何人。我们的职责是找出这些想法，通过坦诚讨论打磨改进，再把它们从概念变成行动。
fullTextParagraphs: These norms preserve the best of the founding Uber culture that built one of the world’s most valuable and important companies, while recognizing that we must adapt to become a great company where every person feels respected and challenged, can contribute in his or her own way, and learn and grow as an individual and as a professional.
We encourage different opinions and approaches to be heard, and then we come together and build.

We seek out problems and we solve them. We help each other and those who matter to us. We have a bias for action and accountability. We finish what we start and we build Uber to last. And when we make mistakes, we’ll own up to them.

We believe that the best ideas can come from anywhere, both inside and outside our company. Our job is to seek out those ideas, to shape and improve them through candid debate, and to take them from concept to action.
verifiedFacts: Uber 的公开资料明确介绍了“不同意团队方案时，怎样把分歧推进成决定”相关的工作做法。
练习情境为虚构职场训练，不代表公司真实员工对话。

scenario.title: Uber工作场景练习（虚构）
english: The team is split between launching a new feature next week and delaying it until Support has reviewed the help content. You see a risk in launching without that review.
State your concern, invite the other view, and suggest an accountable next step that moves the decision forward.
chinese: 团队对下周是否发布新功能意见不一：有人想按期发布，有人主张等支持团队审核帮助内容后再发。你认为未经审核就发布有风险。
说明顾虑、邀请对方观点，并提出能推动决定落地且有人负责的下一步。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请在项目频道写三句：指出客户帮助内容尚未审核；邀请发布负责人说明按期上线的理由；建议今天决定是否先做小范围试点。
firstAttempt.sample: I see one risk: Support hasn’t reviewed the help content yet. I’d like to hear the launch lead’s view before we decide. Could we agree today whether to run a small pilot first?
firstAttempt.rationale: 先独立组织信息，再比较示范中的目标、行动和时间表达。

structure.original: Our job is to seek out those ideas, to shape and improve them through candid debate, and to take them from concept to action.
analysis: 用 to seek、to shape、to take 串联找想法、讨论打磨和落实行动。
把原文表达迁移到新的工作任务中，补上明确行动和时间。

rewrite.bad: Your plan is wrong. We should not do it.
rewrite.good: I see a risk in launching before the reporting fields are confirmed. Could we hear the data team’s view? Let’s decide today whether to run a small pilot or wait.

rewrite.pattern: State the specific issue or goal. Add the action, owner, and timing.

options: That’s a bad idea and I won’t support it.
I see a risk in launching before review. Could we hear the other team’s view and decide today whether to run a small pilot?
choice.why: 基于事实说明顾虑、邀请不同意见，并给出决策路径。
